findings.quoted_text: Either party may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.
Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except to the extent a different limitation is required by applicable law.
Minor clarifications may be made through ordinary project communications, provided that such clarification does not materially increase the workload.
Either party may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.
findings.explanation: Termination for convenience allows the client to cancel the project at any time with short notice. While it requires paying for performed services, it does not compensate for lost profits or committed expenses.
findings.suggested_change: Require a kill fee or full compensation for all scheduled milestone work upon termination for convenience.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
findings.explanation: Net 30 payment terms create cash flow delays for freelancers, requiring you to finance project operations for a month after invoicing.
findings.suggested_change: Change payment terms to Net 15 or upon receipt.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except to the extent a different limitation is required by applicable law.
findings.explanation: The liability cap of USD 35,000 exceeds the total project fee of USD 24,875, exposing you to potential damages higher than the total revenue from the contract.
findings.suggested_change: Cap liability at fees paid or payable under this Agreement (USD 24,875) or lower.

findings.quoted_text: Minor clarifications may be made through ordinary project communications, provided that such clarification does not materially increase the workload.
findings.explanation: Vague definitions of minor clarifications in ordinary communications can lead to cumulative extra tasks that add up without formal change orders.
findings.suggested_change: Define specific thresholds for minor clarifications and require written sign-off for any task modification.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am reviewing the contract and would like to propose a few adjustments to the agreement before we sign. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination for convenience, the current terms allow cancellation on short notice without covering committed expenses, so I propose requiring full compensation for scheduled milestone work upon termination. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, Net 30 can create cash flow delays, and I propose changing the terms to Net 15 or upon receipt. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, the current cap exceeds the total project fee, and I propose capping liability at fees paid or payable under the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on minor clarifications, vague definitions can lead to cumulative extra tasks, so I propose defining specific thresholds and requiring written sign-off for any task modification. Thank you for your understanding, and please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards
